## Services

- [AI Workflow Automation for Marketing Teams](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/ai-automation): Lead capture, automated follow-up, voice agents, content engines and reporting built with n8n, Zapier, Make and the OpenAI API.
- [Performance Marketing Tuned to CTR, ROAS and Conversion](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/performance-marketing): Funnel planning, paid campaigns and analytics where budget follows measured results.
- [AI-Assisted Copy & Content That Keeps Your Brand Voice](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/ai-copy-content): Ad copy, landing pages and SEO articles produced with AI speed and human editorial control.
- [AI Strategy & Workflow Audits](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/ai-strategy): Workflow audits scored by payback speed, tool selection between n8n, Zapier, Make and custom builds, and a sequenced automation roadmap.

## Blog

- [AI Marketing Automation: A Practical Guide for Small Teams (2026)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-marketing-automation-guide-2026): What to automate first, which tools to use, and how to build AI marketing workflows with n8n, Zapier and Make.
- [n8n vs Zapier vs Make in 2026: Which Automation Tool Should Marketers Choose?](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/n8n-vs-zapier-vs-make-marketing): A side-by-side comparison of the three leading automation platforms for marketing.
- [AI Copywriting in 2026: Where It Works, Where It Fails, and How to Keep Brand Voice](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-copywriting-where-it-works-2026): How to run an AI-assisted copy workflow that actually converts.
- [How to Optimize Your Website for AI Search (GEO): A 2026 Playbook](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/optimize-website-for-ai-search-geo-2026): Citable passages, brand mentions, freshness and schema for AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity.
- [What Is AI Automation & Performance Marketing? (Definition & How It Works)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/what-is-ai-automation-performance-marketing): A plain-language definition of the role and how the two halves combine.
- [RAG for Marketing: Grounding AI in Your Own Content (2026)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/rag-for-marketing-2026): How retrieval-augmented generation lets AI answer from your own documents.
- [AI Agents vs Workflows: What Marketers Actually Need in 2026](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-agents-vs-workflows-marketing): When to build a fixed workflow and when an autonomous agent earns its keep.

## Key facts

- Mueed Nazir Bhat is an AI automation and performance marketing specialist from Srinagar, India, currently building the AI automation behind growth work at Anarchy Labs.
- He combines a 3+ year marketing and copywriting background with AI automation using LLMs, n8n, Zapier and Make.
- He designs end-to-end marketing automations from lead capture to follow-up, and builds funnels and paid campaigns tuned to CTR, ROAS and conversion.
- Recent AI-assisted client campaigns lifted brand visibility by 35% and engagement by 28%; automated content workflows cut production time and revision cycles by 25%.
- He has an M.Com from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, and a B.Com from the University of Delhi.
- He is a team member at Anarchy Labs (https://www.anarchylabs.in/team/mueed-nazir-bhat), and was Marketing Strategist & Copywriter at Sadat Paints & Plastics Pvt. Ltd. from Feb 2022 to Sep 2025.
